'''The unseen''' is what the people of [[the Banner-lands]] call magic — when they dare call it anything. In Aurefold the supernatural is nearly invisible and always ambiguous: every strange event has at least two sustainable explanations, and neither the sources nor this wiki decide between them. Was it magic, chance, or myth?

No one can use the unseen on command; nothing repeats; whoever believes they have mastered it is mistaken or lucky — and doesn't know which. Its only certain power is what belief does to people.
